source.author: stat
source.text: hinc praeterveetus Nisum et te, mitis Eleusin, laevus abit, iamque arva gradu Teumesia et arces intrat Agenoreas; ibi durum Eteoclea cernit sublimem solio saeptumque horrentibus armis.
source.text_original: hinc praeterveetus Nisum et te, mitis Eleusin, / laevus abit, iamque arva gradu Teumesia et arces / intrat Agenoreas; ibi durum Eteoclea cernit / sublimem solio saeptumque horrentibus armis.
source.text_english: Then, passing by Nisa and you, gentle Eleusin, he goes off to the left, and now with his step enters the Teumesian fields and the Agenorean citadel; there he sees hard Eteocles, towering on his throne and fenced about with bristling arms.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nuntius hunc solio Boreas proturbat ab alto:
reuse.text_original: nuntius hunc solio Boreas proturbat ab alto: /
reuse.text_english: Boreas drives this man from his high throne by a messenger.
